title: Degree and Galois property over the fixed field of a finite faithful field action
statement: Let $L$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], let $G$ be a finite group, and let $\rho:G\to\operatorname{Aut}(L)$ be an injective group homomorphism, where $\operatorname{Aut}(L)$ consists of field automorphisms. Put $L^G=\{x\in L:\rho(g)(x)=x\text{ for every }g\in G\}$, with its induced field operations. Then $L/L^G$ is finite Galois: it is finite-dimensional, separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and normal (every element's minimal polynomial over $L^G$ splits over $L$). Moreover $[L:L^G]=|G|$, where the degree denotes vector-space dimension.
